long_description:
An Exciting Night of Celebration at San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
Mark your calendars for the 23rd of October, 2026, as Net Effect Media brings you an unforgettable night of fun and celebration at the San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite. This event promises a wonderful fusion of Hindi, Telugu, Gujarati, English, and Punjabi cultures, all set under the vibrant lights of a Night Party. Come join us and immerse yourself in the spirit of Navratri/Dandiya. Enjoy delicious Food & Drink options, dance to the pulsating rhythms of Bollywood music, and witness a thrilling Live in Concert performance that will leave you breathless.
Immerse in a Unique Cultural Fusion
San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite is more than just a party; it's an experience. It is a unique opportunity to witness the harmonious interplay of various cultures coming together on a single stage. With the focus on Hindi, Telugu, Gujarati, English, and Punjabi traditions, the event offers a rich and diverse cultural experience that is sure to captivate and thrill attendees.
Experience the Charm of Marriott Residence Inn
The event will take place at the prestigious Marriott Residence Inn, located at 19429 Stevens Creek Boulevard, Cupertino, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the venue makes for a perfect setting for an evening of fun and celebration. As a bonus, the area boasts several nearby attractions and a plethora of Indian restaurants so you can continue the party even after the event concludes. Ample parking is also available for your convenience.
Secure Your Tickets for a Night to Remember
Don't miss out on what promises to be an unforgettable night! We offer a variety of ticket options to suit all budgets and group sizes. Grab your Early Bird - Single Ticket for just $24.00 or bring your friends along with our Early Bird - 4 Tickets option for $89.00. For larger groups, the Early Bird - 10 Tickets can be availed for $199.00. If you miss the early bird offer, worry not! Regular Single Tickets are priced at $26.00, 4 Tickets for $96.00, and 10 Tickets for $220.00. Even last-minute planners can join the fun with At the Door - Single Tickets at $29.00, 4 Tickets for $108.00, and 10 Tickets for $249.00.
